purpose: Official-school documentary evidence for NCAA preseason player identity exceptions; evidence only, no production ratings change

cases.observation: Official Vanderbilt bio explicitly states 2025-26 at Washington State; official WSU bio lists 2025-26 freshman production. Fuzzy historical ID must not be accepted until historical identifier and school code are checked against source.
Bradley official bio lists Guimarães as redshirt freshman in 2026-27 and says he redshirted without game action in 2025-26; no 2025-26 D1 player minutes should be fabricated.
Official Dayton 2026-27 roster lists Jalen Haynes, graduate forward number 9; roster listing alone does not adjudicate conflicting prior-school IDs.
